name: offline-ui-verification
purpose: Self-contained offline Playwright ui-contract and mobile geometry verification lab.

ui-contract.purpose: Fast, deterministic verification of password recovery error handling and 390x844 mobile drawer geometry without external services.

authSessionPolicy.rationale: Concurrent workers sharing one single-use refresh token trigger reuse detection and revoke the session family.

scenarios.title: Password recovery HTTP 503 preserves typed email and makes zero background retries
Mobile release drawer fits 390x844 viewport without horizontal overflow or off-screen controls

programmaticInvariants: dialog close button inside viewport boundingBox

Primary action button remains visually distinct and unobstructed

skills.name: verify-browser-scenarios
skills.description: Verify UI-contract Playwright scenarios with ARIA locators, DOM geometry invariants, and targeted VLM screenshots. Use when an issue or task packet references M-AUTH-01 or M-UX-01.
